digest.component_or_area: generated surface markers and drift gates
propositions: Plans are citing derived files by line number instead of their sources, causing implementers to edit generated artifacts rather than sources and triggering drift gate failures that block CI for 10+ minutes per round-trip
Two JSON derived files (index.json and criterion-pins.json) carry no markers saying they are generated because JSON has no comment syntax, making them indistinguishable from hand-authored files
There is no centralized inventory listing which of nine surfaces are derived, forcing authors to already know which files are generated in order to edit the correct source
Markers added to generated JSON files must be fixed points emitted by the generators themselves so regeneration reproduces them byte-for-byte and drift gates remain green
Existing on-disk equality tests must be re-pointed from pure builders to marker-bearing serialized outputs without changing the pure builders' invariant tests
